quests.instruction: What is the action word for being in charge of organizing a task or a team?
quests.hint: Think about being the one who keeps track of every part of a big group project.
quests.explanation: Manage means to be in charge of organizing a task. A team captain helps manage the team!
quests.funFact: Managing a big project well often means breaking it into smaller, easier steps!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for going first and showing others the way?
quests.hint: Think about walking at the very front of a line to show everyone the way.
quests.explanation: Lead means to go first and show others the way. We lead our friends on a nature walk!
quests.funFact: A good leader listens carefully to the whole group before deciding which way to go!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for helping someone find their way or understand something?
quests.hint: Think about helping a new student find their way around a big school.
quests.explanation: Guide means to help someone find their way. We guide a new student around our school!
quests.funFact: A tour guide helps visitors understand and enjoy a new place!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for telling people exactly what to do to make something happen?
quests.hint: Think about telling each actor exactly where to stand during a school play.
quests.explanation: Direct means to tell people exactly what to do. A director directs actors during a play!
quests.funFact: A movie director directs every single actor and camera to make a great film!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for giving someone clear steps to follow?
quests.hint: Think about giving a friend clear steps to follow to build a paper airplane.
quests.explanation: Instruct means to give someone clear steps to follow. We instruct a friend how to fold a paper airplane!
quests.funFact: Instructions work best when each step is clear and easy to follow in order!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for showing someone exactly how to do something?
quests.hint: Think about showing a friend exactly how to tie a shoelace, step by step.
quests.explanation: Demonstrate means to show someone exactly how to do something. We demonstrate how to tie a shoelace!
quests.funFact: Watching someone demonstrate a skill can make it much easier to learn!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for helping someone complete a task?
quests.hint: Think about helping a classmate carry a heavy stack of books.
quests.explanation: Assist means to help someone complete a task. We assist a classmate carrying heavy books!
quests.funFact: Assisting someone kindly, even in a small way, can make their day much easier!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for going somewhere together with another person?
quests.hint: Think about walking to the library together with a friend.
quests.explanation: Accompany means to go somewhere together with someone. We accompany a friend to the library!
quests.funFact: Accompanying someone on a trip makes the whole journey more fun and less lonely!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for saving someone or something from danger?
quests.hint: Think about firefighters helping a kitten safely down from a tall tree.
quests.explanation: Rescue means to save someone or something from danger. Firefighters rescue a kitten from a tree!
quests.funFact: Rescue workers train for a long time so they can help people and animals safely!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully watching over someone or something to keep it safe?
quests.hint: Think about a dog watching carefully over its family's front yard.
quests.explanation: Guard means to carefully watch over something to keep it safe. A dog can guard its family's yard!
quests.funFact: Guarding something well means staying alert and paying close attention!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for protecting your team's goal so the other team cannot score?
quests.hint: Think about standing in front of the goal to stop the other team from scoring.
quests.explanation: Defend means to protect your team's goal from the other team. Players defend the goal in soccer!
quests.funFact: A strong defense can be just as important as scoring goals in many sports!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for sharing information or feelings with someone else?
quests.hint: Think about sharing your ideas clearly so your whole class understands them.
quests.explanation: Communicate means to share information or feelings with someone. We communicate our ideas clearly in class!
quests.funFact: People communicate in many ways, including talking, writing, and even hand signals!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for caring for land or plants so they grow well?
quests.hint: Think about carefully caring for a garden so the vegetables grow big and healthy.
quests.explanation: Cultivate means to care for land or plants so they grow well. Farmers cultivate fields of crops!
quests.funFact: Cultivating a garden takes patience, care, and a lot of watering!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for focusing your full attention on just one thing?
quests.hint: Think about focusing so hard on a puzzle that you forget everything else around you.
quests.explanation: Concentrate means to focus your full attention on one thing. We concentrate hard while solving a puzzle!
quests.funFact: A quiet space can help you concentrate much better on a tricky task!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for pausing for a moment because you feel unsure?
quests.hint: Think about pausing for just a second before jumping into a cold pool.
quests.explanation: Hesitate means to pause for a moment because you feel unsure. We hesitate before jumping into cold water!
quests.funFact: It is okay to hesitate for a moment when you need extra time to feel ready!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looking forward to something you expect will happen?
quests.hint: Think about the excited feeling you have the night before a big birthday party.
quests.explanation: Anticipate means to look forward to something you expect. We anticipate our birthday party all week!
quests.funFact: Anticipating a fun event can make the whole week leading up to it feel exciting!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for thinking quietly and deeply about something?
quests.hint: Think about sitting quietly and thinking deeply while watching a beautiful sunset.
quests.explanation: Contemplate means to think quietly and deeply about something. We contemplate quietly while watching a sunset!
quests.funFact: Taking quiet time to contemplate can help you understand your own thoughts better!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for changing words from one language into another?
quests.hint: Think about changing a word from Spanish into English so a friend understands.
quests.explanation: Translate means to change words from one language into another. We translate a word to help a friend understand!
quests.funFact: Translators help people who speak different languages understand each other!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for finding your way from one place to another?
quests.hint: Think about using a map to find your way through a big new city.
quests.explanation: Navigate means to find your way from one place to another. We navigate a new city using a map!
quests.funFact: Sailors once used the stars to help them navigate across the ocean!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for working the controls of a machine?
quests.hint: Think about pressing the right buttons to make a remote-control car move.
quests.explanation: Operate means to work the controls of a machine. We operate a remote-control car with its buttons!
quests.funFact: Learning to operate a new machine safely takes careful reading of the instructions!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting things apart into different groups?
quests.hint: Think about putting the red blocks in one pile and the blue blocks in another.
quests.explanation: Separate means to put things apart into different groups. We separate our red blocks from our blue blocks!
quests.funFact: Separating recycling from trash helps take good care of our planet!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for teaching someone new facts or skills over time?
quests.hint: Think about what a whole school full of teachers does for its students every day.
quests.explanation: Educate means to teach someone new facts or skills. Schools educate students every single day!
quests.funFact: Being educated helps you understand the world and make thoughtful decisions!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for copying the way someone else acts or sounds?
quests.hint: Think about a parrot copying the exact words that a person says.
quests.explanation: Imitate means to copy the way someone else acts or sounds. A parrot can imitate what people say!
quests.funFact: Baby animals often imitate their parents to learn important skills!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making an exact copy of something?
quests.hint: Think about carefully copying a friend's drawing so it looks exactly the same.
quests.explanation: Replicate means to make an exact copy of something. We replicate a friend's drawing to match it exactly!
quests.funFact: Tiny cells inside your body replicate themselves to help you grow!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for producing or creating something, like energy or ideas?
quests.hint: Think about how spinning a pinwheel can generate a fun breeze of your own.
quests.explanation: Generate means to produce or create something. Windmills generate electricity from the wind!
quests.funFact: Solar panels generate electricity using nothing but sunlight!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for turning something on so it starts working?
quests.hint: Think about pressing a button to turn on a toy robot.
quests.explanation: Activate means to turn something on so it starts working. We activate a toy robot with a button!
quests.funFact: Activating a device is the very first step before you can use it!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for lighting something up brightly?
quests.hint: Think about how a lamp lights up a dark room.
quests.explanation: Illuminate means to light something up brightly. A lamp illuminates a dark room!
quests.funFact: Fireflies illuminate the night sky using a special glow from their own bodies!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for fixing up an old building to make it new again?
quests.hint: Think about painting and fixing up an old, worn-down treehouse.
quests.explanation: Renovate means to fix up something old to make it new again. We renovate an old treehouse with fresh paint!
quests.funFact: Renovating an old building can give it a whole new life!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for raising something up to a higher position?
quests.hint: Think about lifting your arm up high to elevate a flag.
quests.explanation: Elevate means to raise something up higher. We elevate a flag up a tall pole!
quests.funFact: An elevator gets its name because it elevates people up to higher floors!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for traveling a long distance to a new place, often with the seasons?
quests.hint: Think about a large flock of birds flying south together every winter.
quests.explanation: Migrate means to travel a long distance, often with the seasons. Birds migrate south for the winter!
quests.funFact: Some birds migrate thousands of miles between their summer and winter homes!
